name: bc-security
description: Read-only security review agent and domain rule plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: bc-security-core
plugins.description: Read-only security review agent, report format and optional hooks.

plugins.name: bc-security-code
plugins.description: Application code security rules for the bc-security reviewer: injection, auth, access control, multitenancy, SSRF, deserialization, XSS and crypto.

plugins.name: bc-security-secrets
plugins.description: Secrets and supply-chain hygiene rules for the bc-security reviewer: hardcoded credentials, committed .env files, lockfiles, version pinning, typosquatting, non-standard sources and install scripts.

plugins.name: bc-security-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure security rules for the bc-security reviewer: Dockerfile hardening, Docker Compose exposure and GitHub Actions permissions, pinning, pull_request_target, script injection and log leaks.

plugins.name: bc-security-ai
plugins.description: AI agent and LLM application security rules for the bc-security reviewer: prompt injection, LLM output handling, excessive agency, MCP server configuration, hidden instructions in skills and plugins, malicious hooks and secrets in system prompts.
